bends.reason: Joggle bend (one of two) on the near long-side lip (B8/B9 side). bend_01 uses the global registration with no local re-fit. The scan follows the blue profile through the full S-shaped joggle: both surfaces dip smoothly between x~0 and x~3 mm. The lip past the joggle sits parallel to the rest of the lip, about 1.3 mm off its line, matching blue. The small lip piece beyond the slot matches the blue loop at x~-12..-9. No scan points lie along the orange unformed reference (rotated about 35 deg). The raw SIDE view shows the stepped lip ends this joggle produces.

Second bend of the B1 joggle. Geometry check: its parent of 19.3 mm equals 22 minus 2.8, and its child of 8.6 mm equals 5.6 plus 2.8, so it is the bend about 2.8 mm from B1 toward the B8 lip bend. In bend_02, after the local parent re-fit, the whole scan profile is shifted about 10 mm along the lip from the CAD: the lip bend is at x~29.6 vs 19.3, the step at ~10 vs 0, the small piece at -4..-0.5 vs -15.5..-12. Its shape is still the formed joggle: a ~2 mm step in the same direction as the CAD, about 19 mm from the lip bend as in the CAD, then the lip segment, the slot and the small piece. No scan points lie along the orange unformed reference. The globally registered bend_01 section shows this same bend formed at the CAD position, and the bend_08 and bend_09 sections show the lip step following blue. The shift is a display artifact of the local re-fit.

Joggle bend (one of two) on the far long-side lip (B6/B11 side). bend_03 uses the global registration with no local re-fit. The scan follows the blue S-shaped step with both bends present. The lip past the joggle sits about 1.3 mm off the line of the rest of the lip, matching blue. The small piece beyond the slot matches the blue loop exactly. No scan points lie along the orange unformed reference.

Second bend of the B3 joggle; the geometry check matches B2's. In bend_04, after the local parent re-fit, the scan profile is shifted about 6.5 mm along the lip: the lip bend is at x~26 vs 19.5 and the step at ~5 vs 0. Its shape is still the formed joggle: a ~1.5 mm step in the same direction as the CAD, about 20 mm from the lip bend as in the CAD, then the slot and the small piece. No scan points lie along the orange unformed reference. The globally registered bend_03 section shows this same bend formed at the CAD position, and the bend_06 and bend_11 sections show the far lip's step following blue. The shift is a re-fit display artifact.

90 deg bend from the short-side wall to its ~12 mm lip. In bend_05 the scan lip hugs the blue profile from the bend to its tip at (-8,-9) mm, square to the wall, and the next 90 deg bend matches as well. No scan points lie along the orange unformed reference.

90 deg bend from the opposite short-side wall to its ~12 mm lip. In bend_07 the scan follows the blue profile to the lip tip at about (-8,-9.5) mm, and the wall and the next bend match blue. No scan points lie along the orange reference.

90 deg bend from the near long-side wall to its lip. In bend_08 the scan follows the blue profile, with the lip present at 90 deg including its joggle step and the small piece beyond the slot. The wall and the next 90 deg bend match blue. No scan points lie along the orange reference.
